name: tty-esc-deny-stops-turn
description: Escaping a tool approval denies that one call AND ends the turn: the model is not called again, the user lands straight back at the prompt, and the call plus its denial still commit so the next message continues from them

steps.name: submit - the model calls create and waits for approval
screenContains: Enter to confirm · Esc to deny

steps.name: deny with Esc - the call is denied and the turn ends right there
steps.waitFor: Stopped. Send a message to continue.
screenContains: Stopped. Send a message to continue.

steps.name: back at the prompt, with no model follow-up in between
submit - the fixture's turn-2 matcher proves this is the model's next call, and messageCount:3 that the denial committed
